title: Saccharide success: exploring the role of D-fructose-based thioureas as organocatalysts for the enantioselective Friedel–Crafts alkylation reaction
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,8335-8345
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00456J, Paper
Open Access

Samson Lalhmangaihzuala, Vanlalngaihawma Khiangte, Khiangte Vanlaldinpuia
In this study, a series of sixteen (16) D-fructose-based bifunctional thioureas were examined as organocatalysts for the enantioselective Friedel–Crafts alkylation of indoles and pyrrole with β-nitrostyrenes.
